'''Reeho''' were [[Color/Legends|colorful]] [[Bird/Legends|birds]] from [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]]. They were hunted for food by the native [[Glarsaur]]. The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[T'laerean Larn]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to merge his mind with the reeho who was named "[[Sunshine (reeho)|Sunshine]]."<ref name="TBoG" />
